newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Anglo American interested in Brazil's CVRD - report.
newsitem.headline: Anglo American interested in Brazil's CVRD - report.

text.p: Anglo American is interested in buying Brazil's state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) according to the president of Brazilian mining company Mineracao Morro Velho (MMV), the Invest News agency reported.
Mineracao Morro Velho is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Minorco, the offshore arm of Anglo American Corp of South Africa.

MMV president Juvenil Felix said Anglo American planned to form a consortium with other companies to participate in the privatization auction of CVRD scheduled for February next year, according to Invest News.
Minorco has already prequalified to visit the CVRD information center which is being opened on Monday at Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) in Rio de Janeiro, Invest News said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
